description: Snap Shot Ninja™ Download Now iPod, iPhone, and iPad!!Snap Shot Ninja™ is the ALL NEW slicing-action game with an AWESOME new feature that no other game can provide! Swipe your finger across the screen to slice, split and splatter fruit, veggies, and whatever you want! That's right! You can custom make the game-play for yourself just by taking a SnapShot Picture of anything! Take a Picture of anything and make your imagination come to life in this *ALL NEW* action packed Ninja Arcade Game. SNAP SHOT NINJA™  - FEATURES 2 PLAYING OPTIONS! *SNAP SHOT MODE* -Take a picture of anything you like -Use the picture cut-out feature -Load Your cut-out into the game-Have crazy fun slicing and splatting your own images! -Choose up to 4 custom images to play with at once! *CLASSIC ARCADE MODE* Play Classic Strike Out with exploding TNT Dynamite! Also enjoy Timed Arcade and try to achieve HIGH SCORES before the clock runs out! Connect with Game Center to compete with others! Snap Shot Ninja™ is the first ninja-slicing game ever that allows you to make your own custom slice & play objects. The sky is the limit with Snap Shot Ninja™. You create your enemies and you create the game!
